workflow: Code and docs in English, conversation in Finnish. cargo fmt + clippy -D warnings + cargo test + pnpm check before every commit; CI on windows-latest runs the same. Commit straight to main while the repo is private and single-author; the Atlas model changes go through a PR on the Atlas repo, then wrangler deploy of the MCP worker. A new decision enters the Atlas model first and is rendered into docs/adr/ by node scripts/adr-from-model.mjs. End a session by updating docs/CHANGELOG.md, docs/BUILD_INFO.json and, if a lesson was learned, docs/LESSONS.md; put the status to Atlas.
